falsifiers.statement: The active F2-WP-603 G1 claim defines R0 as no child recursion and R1/R2/R3 as child recursion depths 1/2/3. Current canonical README.md instead defines F2-WP-603 as 'R0 deterministic / R1 model recursion / R2 child harness / R3 adaptive selection' and GRID cell G9 as 'Delegation / native child / R0-R3 recursion routing'. The active claim therefore collapses four distinct execution/selection classes into a depth-only interpretation and drops the explicit model-recursion and adaptive-selection semantics.
falsifiers.minimal_regression: A contract-level test must distinguish at least: R0 deterministic local path; R1 model-recursion candidate with no child requirement; R2 native-child-harness candidate; R3 adaptive selection among admitted lower mechanisms. A depth-only router that maps R1/R2/R3 to nested child depths fails this semantic test even if numeric depth bounds are internally consistent.
falsifiers.risk: If implemented as claimed, WP603 can incorrectly require child capacity for R1 model recursion, conflate R2 harness selection with recursion depth 2, and treat R3 as depth 3 instead of the adaptive policy layer. That would create a misleading Stage-6 contract which later WP604 nested-spawn/generation handling would have to undo.

completion_deficit: The active WP603 worker must re-enter current main and either (a) correct the G1 implementation/claim to preserve the canonical four-class semantics while retaining explicit nested-depth bounds as a separate dimension, or (b) produce an explicit owner/contract authority that supersedes README.md before accepting a depth-only design. Until then, withhold bounded WP603 acceptance even if repository CI is green.
next_exact_action: Active WP603 mutation authority should absorb this review before source acceptance: model R0/R1/R2 as distinct candidate mechanisms, model R3 as adaptive selection policy, keep recursion depth orthogonal and bounded by the accepted Native Child ABI, add regressions proving R1 does not require a child and R3 is not equivalent to depth 3, then run exact PR-head and merged-main repository-hosted CI.
